name: Failed State
storyline: The world as we knew it is shattered. Decades of environmental neglect have unleashed cataclysmic natural disasters – earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions, and technological meltdowns – leaving civilization in ruins. Most cities are in rubble, and the desperate remnants of humanity struggle to survive and prevent further devastation. In this ravaged world, Failed State throws you into the heart of post-apocalyptic Ukraine, where you'll experience the harrowing journey of Rose, a young woman who barely remembers the old world.
summary: In Failed State, your primary objective is survival. As winter approaches, you must scavenge resources, explore the devastated city, and make difficult choices to stay alive. Prepare to face moral dilemmas where every decision carries dire consequences. Will you sacrifice others to save yourself, or risk everything for the greater good?
